set.name: element
set.param: Size of the element (width, height) in units of the renderer's Space. The position comes from Transform and Anchor.
Position, rotation and scale, applied around the Anchor. Inside Row/Column the layout places the element and Transform is only visual.

Point of the element that lies at the origin of its parent space (TopLeft: the top-left corner; Center: the element is centered on it), resolved against the actual size. Transform rotates and scales around it. Inside Row/Column only the pivot of Transform.

Opacity of the element, including its children. 0 = not drawn and costs no render time, but the element keeps its space in Row/Column and still receives input. Enabled off removes the element from the layout instead.
Clips the drawing of the element and of its children to the element's size: text that overflows, the overhang of a cropped Image and children outside the frame are cut.

Draws the debug overlay of this element only, not of its children (the Debug pin of Renderer [Qt] shows all elements); it does not change layout or hit-testing. The colors are explained at the Debug pin of Renderer [Qt] and in the help patch HowTo Debug Overlay.
Chain of interaction nodes (Hover, Click, …). Without interaction the element is transparent for input.

Chain of effect nodes (Blur, DropShadow, Glow, ColorAdjust, Mask, …), drawn as one effect layer on the element. Size, transform, layout and hit-testing stay the same. Without effect the element has no layer.
False takes the element out of the scene: not drawn, no input and no space in Row/Column (the siblings move up), while it keeps its state. Opacity 0 keeps the gap instead.
Size the element takes with Auto Size on, in units (last frame).
Bounds in window coordinates after layout and transform, in units (last frame).
set.returns: The element; connect it to Renderer [Qt] or a Group.

set.name: autosize
set.param: Size of the element (width, height) in units of the renderer's Space, only with Auto Size off. The position comes from Transform and Anchor.

set.name: plain
set.param: No visible effect on this element: it never paints outside its size, so nothing is cut (checked with stroke and with DropShadow, which Clip does not cut either). The pin is here so that every element has the same pins.
Always 0, 0: this element has no content size of its own.

set.name: shape
set.param: Position, rotation and scale, applied around the origin of the parent space. Inside Row/Column the layout places the element and Transform is only visual.
Clips the drawing to the extent (0, 0) to (max X, max Y) of the points: the stroke and points outside it are cut.
Chain of interaction nodes (Hover, Click, …). Without interaction the element is transparent for input. Hit-testing uses the extent (0, 0) to (max X, max Y) of the points, not the stroke.

set.name: container
set.param: Style passed on to the widgets inside (field by field; a widget's own style overrides it).

set.name: widget
set.param: Opacity of the widget. 0 = not drawn and costs no render time, but the widget keeps its space in Row/Column and still receives input.
Chain of interaction nodes (Hover, Click, …). The widget takes its input itself in any case; the chain adds hover, press and pointer handling.

Channel of the value. Changes from the patch are shown; changes by the user are written into it (author "Qt"). A plain value or an IOBox on the pin is the start value and sets the value whenever it changes. If the patch and the user change the value in the same frame, the user wins.

set.name: effect
set.param: On: the effect is applied. Off: the effect chain passes on unchanged, as if this node was not there.
